subject.title: Plugin context engines cannot increment /status compaction count

question: Which plugin-facing compaction reporting contract should OpenClaw support for context engines that own compaction: an `afterTurn` notification callback, an `afterTurn` result shape, or a status/stats query surface?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix changes the context-engine/plugin lifecycle contract and needs owner intent before implementation.

options.title: Add a notification callback
options.body: Pass a narrow `notifyCompaction(count?)` callback in post-turn and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

options.title: Return compaction metadata
options.body: Allow `afterTurn` to return a small result object, trading a broader signature change for direct host reconciliation.

options.title: Query engine stats
options.body: Add an optional stats surface for status rendering, but it must avoid creating a second source of truth beside session state.

recommendation.title: Add a notification callback
recommendation.body: Pass a narrow `notifyCompaction(count?)` callback in post-turn and maintenance params so engines can increment the canonical session counter only after successful owned compactions.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the context-engine plugin API and maintenance lifecycle where this reporting contract would live.
